products.name: Booster Box
products.note: 36 packs. The Unlimited box has no TCGplayer market price (the one listing asks $100,000), so it is priced at 36 packs; the 1st Edition and Shadowless boxes are not separate here. (TCGplayer product 185731.)
products.priceSource: 36 packs at TCGplayer's Unlimited booster pack market price ($927.56); TCGplayer lists the box with no market price and only an asking mid of $100,000, a single listing

products.name: 2-Player Starter Set
products.note: Two 30-card half decks (Fighting and Fire, 14 Energy each) and a 1st Edition holo Machamp, the only holo of the set and not in any booster pack; rulebook and 10 damage counters, no coin (Bulbapedia '2-Player Starter Set (TCG)', TCGplayer 136400 and 107602). TCGplayer's Revised reprint run listing; the deck lists are not on record.
